newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds via 3-day system RPs, coupon pass possible.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds via 3-day system RPs, coupon pass possible.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system through a round of three-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Monday, the New York Fed confirmed.
The operation was expected, given the Fed's large add need seen this week.
Federal funds were trading at its 5-1/4 percent target rate at the time of the intervention.
Analysts said the Fed could still add permanent reserves via a coupon pass as early as this session, as the add need is expected to continue rising through the rest of the month.
